item.title: Fault Tolerance
item.author: netproxy@duck.com (DSUNDAR)
item.description: Fault tolerance is the ability of a system to continue operating correctly when one or more of its components fail. Instead of crashing or returning corrupted results, a fault-tolerant system isolates the problem, switches to a healthy component, or gracefully degrades so that users still get value.
